_comment: Append-only record of what has actually been observed for this design version (SECDA-TFLite's test_status convention).
Levels: builds_sim | cross_compiles | runs_on_hardware | verified_accurate. Outcomes: pass | fail | crash | blocked.

records.notes: SECDA-Core axi_support v6 port (SECDA-LLM ee990bb, SECDA-Core e1c1abc). Against v5 baselines taken first on the same WIP sources: test-backend-ops -b SECDA MUL_MAT 51/51 and SOFT_MAX 212/212 llama-perplexity MobileLLM-125M-HF Q2_K (-c 128 --chunks 2 -b 128) 3.3449 +/- 0.59780 unchanged, and equal to the x86 CPU-only build; llama-cli greedy tokens and simulated cycle counters identical. Same for driver_batches (55/55). HWC_Reset now declared after the monitors (bea4143); simulation unchanged.
SECDA-aarch64-kria preset (BUILD_KRIA, ACC_PRELOAD, secda_corev6); driver and driver_batches both compile.

First hardware build through the SECDA-Core flow: BFPP_ACC_KRIA_4_0, KRIA_dma_4_hp_4_ctrl_hwc.tcl, 200 MHz (FCLK 199.998), timing-tolerated, WNS -0.217 ns (4.3%), WHS/WPWS >= 0, IO and utilization gates pass, .hwh addresses match acc_config.sc.h. kriaB_L (kernel 1027+secda1), PYNQ load as root, test_0928b checksummed. test-backend-ops -b SECDA MUL_MAT 51/51 SOFT_MAX 212/212 vs CPU; llama-perplexity 3.3625 +/- 0.60376, identical to the board's CPU-only build (x86 gives 3.3449: CPU-op rounding differs between ARM and x86, not the accelerator); llama-cli greedy tokens as in simulation; 30/30 MUL_MAT nodes preloaded. No cma_alloc failure, no u-dma-buf left, board reset to CPU_1_0.

Minimal llama.cpp fork (625ec1d28: backend registration only) with the backend planning from graph_optimize (875e34b) and the secda-* tools (srcs/tools). Same BFPP_ACC_KRIA_4_0 bitstream. kriaB_L test_0928c, driver and driver_batches: secda-test-backend-ops MUL_MAT 51/51 (driver_batches 55/55), SOFT_MAX 212/212; llama-perplexity 3.3625 +/- 0.60376 (= board CPU-only build); secda-llama-cli 30/30 nodes preloaded in every plan, no SECDA WARNING, generated text identical to simulation; secda-llama-bench and secda-llama-cli write llama_perf.csv, synth vtbo/tbo written. No cma_alloc failure, no u-dma-buf left. Simulation: 68/68 gate checks identical to the pre-change baseline.
